title: Dowst narration stimuli: three draft specimens for humdrum/bizarre sorting trial
purpose: Provides the actual paragraph-length stimulus texts described in Scout's experiment brief (artifact 4294ad45-e562-405b-92c3-a162cf40b241). Variants A, B and C share identical word-count targets (~110 words) and vocabulary register. A and B use the same bizarre premise (furniture rearranged overnight, Seed Z) with different Dowst methods; C uses the humdrum premise (Seed H) as a control. Intended for the two-task blind-reader scoring protocol defined in scoring.md.
